integrity: The model equation and equilibrium coordinate are reconstructed directly from the open source article. The proof is exact and uses invariance of log top-predator density plus an algebraic concavity defect; the bundled checker verifies the algebra. Search-based originality assessment is non-exhaustive, and one closely related 2018 source was available only at metadata/abstract level.
scientific_limitations: The theorem gives necessary constraints for compact positive invariant measures and, in strict form, non-equilibrium ergodic measures and positive nonconstant periodic orbits. It does not establish existence, uniqueness, stability, bifurcation direction, basin geometry, persistence, or a corresponding statement for invariant measures whose support reaches the boundary of the positive octant.
title: Exact recurrence crossing and mean-elevation law in a fear-controlled food chain
